title: Spritzguss teile.jpg
author: Gmhofmann
used_as: Sh1-Sh2b (0-17.6 s): the four rings (in Sh1 set down one by one, one turned, a handmade light passing) and the four-arm runner, cut out with GrabCut and animated as puppets. DECLARED COLOUR SUBSTITUTION: the photographed plastic is teal; its own shading is re-lit through a handmade red/amber thickness gel because no openly licensed red or amber runner photograph was found. Its measured geometry also lays out the mould cavities (Sh3) and the tree vocabulary (Sh4). Adaptations are CC BY-SA 4.0.

title: Injection mold - (11).jpg
author: Bricetofly
used_as: Sh3a-Sh3b (17.3-27.6 s): the mould steel, quilted from the photograph's plain plate areas with one real socket screw kept, its machining texture contrast-raised so it survives the encode; refracted through the handmade melt simulation; emptied cavities lit as single recesses.

title: Granuls orange.jpg
author: Lobkovs
used_as: Sh5 (35-38 s): the real heap of plastic granules, cut out with GrabCut onto black, its real orange colour kept; handmade pellets land on it. Its measured lit granule colour is also the colour the handmade drops freeze to in Sh4. Adaptation CC BY-SA 3.0.

title: Gigaset Cordless Telephone Production II - Engel Injection Moulding Machine.webm
author: Sound Recordist: Kathinka Engels, Photographer: Inke Pickhardt, Video Recordist: Inke Pickhardt (Work With Sounds / soundsofchanges.eu), via Wikimedia Commons
used_as: sound only: the press bed under L3 (18.8-27.4 s), audio 2.0-12.8 s of the source, band-limited 30-2500 Hz, about -24 dB, ducked under each L3 pulse and the caesura gap.
